Package au.csiro.pathling.terminology.conceptmap

Class ConceptMapReader

java.lang.Object
au.csiro.pathling.terminology.conceptmap.ConceptMapReader
public class ConceptMapReader extends Object
Reads a concept map from a FHIR terminology server in three steps: a summary search of ConceptMap resources by canonical URL (and version, where pinned), following next links and keeping the entries whose url equals the request exactly; a choice among the entries, taking the one entry a pinned reference matches and the latest of several an unpinned reference matches; and one read of the chosen resource, converted with ConceptMapContent.fromResource(org.hl7.fhir.r4.model.ConceptMap, int). No other request is made, so the content of a version that is not chosen is never fetched.

A search answered with any 4xx status or 501 means the server holds no concept map at the URL, or does not search them, and is reported as empty. Any other 5xx, or a server that cannot be reached, leaves it unknown whether the URL names a concept map at all and is reported as a ConceptMapLookupException. A failure of the read, once a map has been chosen, is a fault in a found map and is reported as a ConceptMapContentException.

Author:
John Grimes

  • Method Details

    • read

      @Nonnull public Optional<ConceptMapContent> read(@Nonnull String url, @Nullable String version, int maxMappings)
      Reads a concept map by canonical URL.
      Parameters:
      url - the canonical URL of the concept map, without a version suffix
      version - the version to read, or null for the latest the server holds
      maxMappings - the largest number of rows the caller will accept
      Returns:
      the content, or empty where the server holds no concept map at the URL
      Throws:
      ConceptMapLookupException - if the search fails with a server error other than 501, or the server cannot be reached
      ConceptMapVersionException - if the version to use cannot be determined
      ConceptMapContentException - if the chosen map cannot be read, or its content cannot be represented
      ConceptMapLimitExceededException - if the map has more than maxMappings rows
